title_sq: Shitet Vile 2 kateshe per Hotel ne Rrugen e Kavajes prane shkolles Faik Konica, Tirane ID (4151153)
description_sq:
Shitet vile 2 kateshe me hipotek & dokumenta te rregullta.Siperfaqja e truallit eshte 100 m².
2 katet e banimit jane 184 m² ne total.
Cdo kat ka: nje sallon te madh & nje dhome ngrenie, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 banja & 1 ballkon.
Shkallet jane te jashtme ku cdo kat lidhet me dere te vecante me shkallen.
Vila eshte me sistem kapote termoizolim i sapo bere, punimet jane cilesore & gjendja e baneses eshte shume e mire.
Aktualisht eshte ne gjendje pune HOTEL.
Shitet 550 000 euro.
title_en: 2-storey Villa for Hotel for sale on Kavaje Street near Faik Konica school, Tirana ID (4151153)
description_en: 2-storey villa for sale with mortgage & regular documents. The surface of the plot is 100 m². The 2 residential floors are 184 m² in total. Each floor has: a large living room & a dining room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms & 1 balcony. The stairs are external where each floor is connected to the stairs by a separate door. The villa has a hood system, newly made thermal insulation, the works are of high quality and the condition of the apartment is very good. It is currently in working condition as a HOTEL. For sale, 550,000 euros.
